name: chat_rooms
description: chat_rooms must reach ck_chat and come back with the rooms listing — the read-only entry point of the whole chat family, and the one an agent is told to call first. The assertion is only the shape (ok:true with a rooms array), because a fresh checkout has no chat state and an empty listing is a correct answer; any populated listing passes identically. It goes red when the chatrooms module wiring or the host round-trip breaks, which no build gate sees. Needs modules.chatrooms enabled, which the shipped config.json sets. The mutating siblings (chat_send, board_add) have no eval on purpose: they persist into shared logs and fan out to peers, so an eval calling them would leave a mark on every run.
prompt: Use the chat_rooms tool with input {}. Look at the tool's JSON result. If its ok field is true and its rooms field is an array — an empty array is fine — reply with exactly ROOMS. Otherwise reply with exactly BROKEN.
